{% aside type="caution" title="Not every glob is supported" %}

The first path segment cannot contain `*`, so `**/generated/**` is not supported. `?`, `!`, `[`, `]` and extglobs are not supported either. Nothing reports these at authoring time, so the pattern has no effect. Anchor it to a directory instead, such as `libs/*/generated/**`.

+A file that `.gitignore` or `.nxignore` excludes is unstable: it can differ between two runs on the same commit. Set `includeUnstableFiles: true` to also hash the recorded reads of such files, such as `dist/libs/ui/index.d.ts`. It defaults to `false`.
+Nx 24.0 always hashes those reads and fails with an error when a target sets the option ([Ultracache and Nx versions](/docs/kb/ultracache-nx-versions#unstable-files-in-nx-240)).
+- Nx matches the recorded reads against the files on disk, so a gitignored file counts whenever it is present.
+- The reads replace the target's declared `includeIgnored` filesets.
+- If the recording read an output of a task this one depends on, Nx hashes the task only after that task runs.
+Changing `includeUnstableFiles` re-runs the task, so its next recording follows the new setting.

+To hash specific unstable files without the rest, leave it off and declare an [`includeIgnored` fileset](/docs/reference/inputs#gitignored-files) or a [`dependentTasksOutputFiles`](/docs/reference/inputs#outputs-of-dependent-tasks) input instead.

+With it off, a recording never makes a task wait for another task. That includes a read of a committed file that another task also writes, such as a generated file checked into the repository: Nx hashes the committed copy. To hash what the other task writes in the current run, declare a [`dependentTasksOutputFiles`](/docs/reference/inputs#outputs-of-dependent-tasks) input for it.
